audit.whatIsWrong: 'Parries your combo + stuns. Bait it.' was the entire interaction note — it never said why the stun happens or what triggers it.
audit.why: Riposte parries all incoming damage and disables, then stabs. The stab slows normally, but stuns if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Cho'Gath's opener is a knockup, so throwing Rupture into a raised Riposte does not merely whiff — it converts her follow-up into a stun on you. That causal link is the entire reason the bait matters and it was never stated. Second missing fact: the parry covers all damage, so Feast spent into it is an 80s cooldown thrown away.
audit.corrected: Riposte parries all damage for its duration, and a knockup blocked by it returns as a stun on you.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns; Feast was 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — the 24s at rank 1 is an enormous window and the single number that makes an early Cho'Gath step-up viable. Lunge is 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7s, Grand Challenge 110/90/70s against Feast's 80s.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Riposte at 24s falling to 16s, Lunge at 13s falling to 6s, Feast 80s versus Grand Challenge 110s.

audit.why: Fiora takes levels 1-5 and both item rows with level 6 as skill — a 50.85% overall rate across 352 games that comes from Cho'Gath's Feast window and teamfight value rather than from lane. No fiora__chogath mirror file exists yet.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr claimed 'her vitals %true shred your HP' and no field mentioned anti-heal or on-hit.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags Fiora on two counts: needs-antiheal via Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge, and onhit-itemization via Lunge, meaning her damage scales with attack speed and armour alone reads the trade wrong. Riot's text confirms the passive heals on Vital hits and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies. The percent-true-damage phrasing is not in Riot's description of the Vitals.
audit.corrected: Grand Challenge heals her and her allies off your health bar — Grievous Wounds before her 6.

audit.why: Template bleed, and it recommended exactly the play the matchup punishes — opening with Rupture into a champion holding a 24s parry.

notes: Riot's text says Riposte stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect; Rupture is a knockup, which is why I wrote the interaction as a certainty. What Riot's text does not settle is whether Feral Scream's silence also counts as an immobilizing effect for that upgrade, so I made no claim about silencing into a raised Riposte. Whether Riposte's parry blocks Feast's true damage specifically is likewise not stated — I wrote only that it parries all incoming damage, which is Riot's own wording. No fiora__chogath mirror existed when I wrote this.
